note: Looks shipped with the Studio (#1221). Each is copied into the Workspace once, by id. An updated look lists in `supersedes` the digests (workspace.AssetWorkspace.card_digest: name, body and lineage) of the versions it replaces: a Workspace copy whose content still matches one was never edited and takes the new version as a revision, put-away state kept. A copy the owner edited keeps the owner's version; the shipped wording stays here to copy from. A look is wording plus its recipe; the owner types only the scene and may switch on its optional lines. Picking one prepares Create and never generates.

body.source_prompt: An empty room, no people. Hand-painted anime film background of a narrow late-night animation workshop loft above a rain-washed city. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark graphite plaster wall, softly lit, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge a tall rain-streaked window shows the city at night and a distant elevated train crossing on a rail line; below it a small wooden desk with stacked blank drawing sheets, a warm amber desk lamp and a small glowing CRT monitor making a soft pool of cyan light. Faint rose and cyan reflections on the wet glass, muted graphite palette with small amber accents. An empty room with nobody in it. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
body.notes: From the accepted anchor's recipe (source_prompt, verbatim). The palette, wet reflections, style, camera and exclusion sentences are kept word for word; the place and its props are the scene, and the scene decides the layout. Loosened 27 September 2026 at the owner's request, after a live render in which 'a rain-soaked arcade entrance' came out as a shutter: the quiet-wall composition sentence left the always-on wording for the optional line 'Keep the quiet wall for UI backgrounds', off by default. With it on, the wording is exactly the template #1224 shipped; then keep the scene's detail at the right edge so the left half stays quiet for text. Z-Image Turbo takes no negative prompt, so the exclusions are in the wording. The loosened wording has not been rendered yet: run 2-4 seeds and judge whether the scene now shapes the picture.
